description: Adjusts a strength guide spec (push_strength_guide's arguments) to how recovered the user is on `date` (default today) and RETURNS the adjusted spec with reasons. It pushes nothing: show the user the changes and push the returned `guide` with push_strength_guide only if they agree. Uses get_baselines (HRV and waking recovery vs the user's 28-day band). Neither below the band, or no reading yet -> unchanged (it never adds load or sets); one below -> one set less on every exercise with 3+ sets (the 'NxM' in detail is rewritten; without one the sets stay and a reason says so); both below -> that plus every load in detail (first '<n>kg') 10% lower rounded to 2.5 kg, plates dropped when the load changed, `target` dropped for changed exercises. Result: level (unchanged | lighter | reduced), signals, reasons, changes, guide, queuePayload (for queue_adjustment; null when nothing changed). The band is the user's own middle half, not a medical reference.

date.description: Day whose HRV and recovery are compared, YYYY-MM-DD (default today). No reading leaves the guide unchanged.

guide.description: Strength guide spec to adjust: push_strength_guide's arguments without guideId.

detail.description: Display string for set steps (and prep unless 'plates' is given), with weight and sets, e.g. '60kg 3x10'.

last.description: Optional: last time, e.g. '3x8@60kg' (get_exercise_history suggestion.last). Shown with target in a 'TODAY' popup at prep (36 characters max: shortened, then dropped). Unverified on a real watch.

plates.description: Per-side plates for barbell lifts, e.g. '2x20+1x5/side', shown on prep. Compute it yourself.

restSec.description: Rest between sets in seconds (countdown length; only a label in 'stopwatch' mode).

restTargetHr.description: Optional HR (bpm, 41-200) to recover to: a gauge on this exercise's rests, visual only.

lapGranularity.description: 'perSet' (default; a lap per set and rest) or 'perExercise'.

title.description: Session name shown in the Suunto app.

name: adjust_guide
title: Adjust a strength guide to today's recovery (returns it, pushes nothing)
